name: self-check
description: Guard-rail reminders for Claude: when the same tool fails twice in a row for the same reason it is asked to find the cause first; when it says done after editing code without verifying, the stop is blocked once

retry_nudge.title: Repeated failure reminder
retry_nudge.description: When the same tool fails twice in a row for the same reason, ask Claude after the second result to find the cause first.

done_check.title: Said done without verifying
done_check.description: When this turn edited code files and no test, build or check ran afterwards, block the stop once and ask Claude to verify.
